name: Formula 1 Driver
definition: A Formula One driver identified by driver id, with reference name, forename, surname, date of birth, nationality and profile URL.
scope: Formula 1 tables; driver id cl0251 is referenced by results, lap times, pit stops, qualifying and standings.

name: Driver Full Name
definition: A driver's display name formed by combining the forename and surname.
scope: Used when a question names a driver such as 'Lewis Hamilton' or 'Bruno Senna'.

name: Driver Age
definition: Driver age in whole years relative to a reference date, derived from the date of birth.
scope: Driver-level age comparisons such as oldest/youngest.

name: Formula 1 Constructor
definition: A Formula One constructor/team with reference name, display name, nationality and profile URL.
scope: Constructor results and standings; constructor id cl0248 is referenced by results and pit/qualifying context.

name: Formula 1 Race
definition: A Grand Prix event within a season, with race id, season year, round, circuit, name, scheduled date and start time.
scope: Race identification and race-level aggregation; race id cl0259 is referenced throughout results tables.

name: Formula 1 Season
definition: A Formula One championship season year.

name: Formula 1 Circuit
definition: A racing circuit/track with reference name, display name, city location, country and latitude/longitude coordinates.
scope: Circuit and venue questions, including country and coordinate lookups.

name: Race Result
definition: One driver's classification in one race: starting grid, classified finish position, points, laps, finish time, fastest lap data and status.
scope: Per-driver-per-race fact table for finishing position, points, times, fastest lap and status.

name: Lap Time
definition: One lap recorded by one driver in one race, with lap number, running position and lap time.

name: Pit Stop
definition: A pit stop made by a driver in a race, with stop sequence, lap, clock time and duration.
scope: Pit stop duration and count questions.

name: Qualifying Result
definition: A driver's qualifying result in a race, with qualifying position and Q1/Q2/Q3 session times.

name: Constructor Race Result
definition: Points scored by a constructor in a single race.
scope: Per-race constructor points, including zero-point cases.

name: Constructor Standing
definition: Constructor championship standings snapshot after a race: points, position and wins.

name: Driver Standing
definition: Driver championship standings snapshot after a race: points, position and wins.

name: Race Status
definition: Classification status of a race entry, such as Finished, Disqualified, Accident, Collision, mechanical failure or lapped.
scope: Interpreting why a driver did not finish and counting accident/retirement statuses.

name: Magic Card Printing
definition: A Magic: The Gathering card printing with name, artist, border color, color identity, frame version, promotional flag, type line, subtypes, supertypes, power, oracle text and set code.
scope: Card-level questions about attributes, artists, power, colors, types and printings.

name: Magic Card Set
definition: A Magic card set/edition with name, code, base set size, total set size, release date and outside-US-only flag.
scope: Set-level questions such as cards in a set, set size or availability region.

name: Localized Card Printing
definition: A language-specific printing of a card with localized name, text, type and print identifier.
scope: Questions about whether a card exists in a language and its localized name/text.

name: Set Name Translation
definition: Localized name of a card set in a given language.
scope: Questions asking for the translation of a set name.

name: Card Legality
definition: Legality status of a card in a play format.
scope: Format legality questions such as legal/banned/restricted in commander.

name: Card Ruling
definition: An official card ruling with date and text.

name: Play Format
definition: A Magic play format label such as commander, modern, vintage, legacy, standard, pauper or pioneer.

name: Card Language
definition: A language label used for card printings and set translations.

name: Molecule
definition: A chemical molecule identified by a molecule id and labelled carcinogenic or non-carcinogenic.
scope: Molecule-level composition, bond and carcinogenicity questions.

name: Atom
definition: An atom in a molecule, identified as moleculeId_atomIndex and carrying an element symbol.

name: Chemical Bond
definition: A bond in a molecule with a bond-order type symbol.

name: Atom Bond Connection
definition: A record linking two bonded atoms to the bond that connects them.
scope: Connectivity questions such as how many connections an atom has or which atoms a bond joins.

name: Chemical Element
definition: Element symbol of an atom, such as c, cl, o or n.

name: Bond Type
definition: Bond order symbol: '-' for single, '=' for double, '#' for triple.

name: Carcinogenicity Status
definition: Molecule carcinogenicity label: '+' carcinogenic, '-' non-carcinogenic.

name: Patient
definition: A patient in the thrombosis dataset with id, sex, birthday, diagnosis text, diagnosis date, admission date and outpatient flag.
scope: Patient-level demographics, diagnosis and age questions.

name: Medical Examination
definition: A dated clinical examination for a patient with observed symptoms, diagnosis and thrombosis severity.

name: Laboratory Test Panel
definition: A dated laboratory panel for a patient containing measured laboratory values.
scope: Lab value questions across examination dates.

name: Thrombosis Severity
definition: Degree of thrombosis recorded at examination: 0 none, 1-3 increasing severity.
scope: Filtering patients by thrombosis presence or severity.

name: Patient Sex
definition: Patient sex code: F female, M male.

name: Diagnosis
definition: Disease diagnosis text recorded for a patient or examination; may contain multiple comma-separated diagnoses and a 'susp' qualifier.
scope: Diagnosis filtering such as SLE, RA, APS or BEHCET.

name: LDH Level
definition: Lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) measured in a laboratory panel.

name: Uric Acid Level
definition: Uric acid concentration measured in a laboratory panel.
scope: Normal/abnormal uric acid questions with sex-specific thresholds.

name: Red Blood Cell Count
definition: Red blood cell count measured in a laboratory panel.

name: Hematocrit Level
definition: Hematocrit level measured in a laboratory panel.

name: Prothrombin Time
definition: Prothrombin time (PT) measured in a laboratory panel.

name: Immunoglobulin A Level
definition: Immunoglobulin A (IgA) level measured in a laboratory panel.

name: Anti-Cardiolipin Antibody
definition: Anti-cardiolipin antibody measurement or qualitative status in a laboratory panel.

name: Anti-SM Antibody
definition: Qualitative anti-SM antibody result in a laboratory panel.

name: Total Cholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol measured in a laboratory panel.

name: Patient Age
definition: Patient age in whole years relative to a reference date, derived from the birthday.
scope: Age filtering such as underage, older than 55 or age at examination.

name: California School
definition: A California school with CDS code, name, status, county, district, address, city, zip, phone, open/close dates, charter flag, charter funding type, district type, ownership/school type and virtual status.
scope: School-level questions about identity, location, status, charter and type.

name: SAT Score Record
definition: School- or district-level SAT aggregate: record type, grade-12 enrollment, test takers and average reading/math/writing scores.

name: FRPM Record
definition: Free/reduced-price-meal record with K-12 enrollment, free meal count, FRPM count and ages 5-17 enrollment counts.
scope: Free meal eligibility and enrollment questions.

name: School District Type
definition: District type code and text such as 52 Elementary School District, 54 Unified School District, 60 High School District or 00 County Office of Education.

name: School Charter Status
definition: Charter school flag: 1 chartered, 0 non-chartered, NULL unknown.

name: School Virtual Status
definition: Virtual/online instruction indicator N/P/F; F means exclusively virtual and therefore no physical building.

name: School Operating Status
definition: School operating status: Active, Closed, Merged or Pending.

name: Free/Reduced-Price Meal Rate
definition: Share of enrolled students eligible for free or reduced-price meals, derived from meal counts and enrollment.

name: Student Club Event
definition: A Student Club event with id, name, date, type, notes and status.
scope: Event-level attendance, status and cost questions.

name: Student Club Member
definition: A Student Club member with id, first/last name, email, position, t-shirt size, phone, zip and major.
scope: Member-level questions about identity, role, contact, size and major.

name: Academic Major
definition: An academic major with name, department and college.

name: Postal Zip Code
definition: A postal zip code with city, county, state and state abbreviation.

name: Event Attendance
definition: Attendance link between an event and a member.

name: Event Budget
definition: A budget line for an event with category, budgeted amount, spent amount, remaining amount and status.

name: Expense
definition: An expense with description, date, cost, approval flag, member and budget.
scope: Expense cost, description, date and approval questions.

name: Income
definition: An income record with date, amount, source and member.

name: Member Full Name
definition: Full name of a club member formed from the first name and last name.
scope: Matching members named by full name.

name: Event Status
definition: Event and budget lifecycle status: Open, Closed or Planning.

name: Superhero
definition: A comic superhero with id, name, full name, gender, eye/hair/skin colour, alignment, publisher, race, height and weight.
scope: Superhero attribute, publisher, alignment, height/weight and power questions.

name: Superhero Attribute
definition: One of six superhero attribute definitions: Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power, Combat.

name: Superhero Attribute Value
definition: Attribute score in the 5-100 range for one superhero on one attribute.
scope: Comparing and ranking heroes by attribute score.

name: Superpower
definition: A named superpower such as Super Strength or Agility.

name: Superhero Power Link
definition: Link between a superhero and a superpower.

name: Comic Publisher
definition: Comic publisher such as Marvel Comics, DC Comics or Dark Horse Comics.

name: Superhero Alignment
definition: Moral alignment: Good, Bad, Neutral or N/A.

name: Superhero Colour
definition: Colour lookup shared by eye, hair and skin colour; includes 'No Colour'.
scope: Eye colour, skin colour and hair colour questions.

name: Superhero Gender
definition: Superhero gender: Male or Female.

name: Superhero Race
definition: Superhero race/species value.

name: Gas Station Customer
definition: A gas-station customer with id, segment (SME/LAM/KAM) and payment currency (CZK/EUR).

name: Gas Station
definition: A gas station with id, chain, country (CZE/SVK) and segment.

name: Gas Product
definition: A gas-station product with id and description.

name: Gas Transaction
definition: A gas-station transaction with date, time, customer, station, product, quantity and total price.
scope: Transaction-level time, location and spend questions.

name: Monthly Consumption
definition: A customer's monthly gas consumption keyed by customer and year-month.

name: Customer/Station Segment
definition: Segment label: SME/LAM/KAM for customers; Discount/Noname/Other/Premium/Value for money for stations.

name: Currency
definition: Payment currency CZK or EUR.

name: Bank Account
definition: A bank account with id, district, statement frequency and opening date.
scope: Account-level questions and joins to loans, orders and transactions.

name: Bank Client
definition: A bank client with id, gender, birth date and district.

name: Bank Card
definition: A bank payment card with id, disposition id, card type (junior/classic/gold) and issue date.

name: Account Disposition
definition: A disposition linking a client to an account with role OWNER or DISPONENT.

name: Bank District
definition: A bank district/branch with name, region, population, urban ratio, average salary, unemployment rates for 1995/1996, entrepreneurs and crime counts for 1995/1996.

name: Bank Loan
definition: A loan with account, date, amount, duration, monthly payment and status.
scope: Loan amount, status and contract questions.

name: Standing Order
definition: A standing order with account, target bank/account, amount and k_symbol.

name: Bank Transaction
definition: An account transaction with date, credit/debit type, operation, amount, balance and counterparty.
scope: Account transaction questions by date, type, operation and amount.

name: Loan Status
definition: Loan contract status A/B/C/D; C and D are still-running contracts and D means in debt.

name: Disposition Type
definition: Account disposition role: OWNER or DISPONENT.

name: Account Frequency
definition: Statement issuance frequency: POPLATEK MESICNE (monthly), POPLATEK TYDNE (weekly), POPLATEK PO OBRATU (after transaction).
